WIC25A-01.note: Flood drowned the predator ants' burrows, so it protected the colony; swamped/starved/stranded all tempt on a surface 'flood harmed beetles' reading and the returning spit kills stranded.

WIC25A-02.note: Wide loops replaced by a trench in a ruler-straight crack; fish still running rules out trapped, and the river still reaches the lake so sidetracked/swallowed fail.

WIC25A-03.note: A relic of the cleared forest that never spreads and is slowly vanishing is a vestige; sentinel is the nearest miss, scaffold is struck quickly.

WIC25A-04.note: Retreat in the 1950s reversed by the 1959+ advance over the same gravel, then stable: short-lived. 'Slight' is a live near-miss on a seventy-year net view, since a full kilometer was lost but how much was regained is not stated exactly.

WIC25A-05.note: Birds stopped halfway and almost none arrived: truncated. 'Staggered' is the near-miss and is killed only by 'set off together on their usual date'.

WIC25A-06.note: Erroneous readings that blocked funding for three decades were setbacks; touchstones and watersheds tempt because they were cited, but they confirmed the status quo rather than turning it.

WIC25A-07.note: Four abrupt drops with level holds between them states 'stepwise' almost outright in one sentence; transient and shallow are directly contradicted.

WIC25A-08.note: Ridge pines that had known drought held up in the 1970s while naive pines did worst: toughened. Stunted/thinned fit the narrowed rings and are refuted only by the recovery and the comparison.

WIC25B-01.note: Violence fell as petitions at the board rose to about the same number: the conflict was redirected, channeled. Deferred and entrenched are near-misses because the conflict persisted.

WIC25B-02.note: Stalls receive, sort and pass on notices of jobs and land: a clearinghouse. Forum is the near-miss but implies discussion, not routing.

WIC25B-03.note: Feast, procession, pledges with no terms, and no change in practice: ceremonial. Exhaustive is struck by 'no fees, schedules, or penalties'; the 'compared the surviving drafts' frame is unsupported by the passage.

WIC25B-04.note: Furnaces banned from the city and the trade moved to one island at the same size and value: confined. Each distractor is killed by one clause (forty=forty, plain cup, still operating).

WIC25B-05.note: Council merely copied and read out the court's orders and forwarded offenders; the court fined: subordinate, ancillary. Coercive is the trap for a reader who sees 'orders' and 'offenders'.

WIC25B-06.note: Editorials set the program the committee followed, even after closure: compass (direction). Engine remains arguable since the paper drove the campaigns, though the tiny readership argues against power/mobilization.

WIC25B-07.note: Teachers added invented details to the quarrel and graduates grew more hostile despite mixed teams: embellished. Defused is the expected-outcome trap; 'embellished the rivalry' is a slightly loose collocation (it was the story that was embellished).

WIC25B-08.note: Copied the scheme the reform journals were praising and honored at the charity ball: fashionable. Frugal (paid more), cumbersome (applied once) and experimental (copied, unchanged to 1920) each fall to one clause.

WIC25C-01.note: Cutting the speeches that carry the queen's motive emptied the play: gutted. Jumbled is struck by 'in the author's sequence', lengthened by 'brisk'.

WIC25C-02.note: She burned the letter but quoted the insult for forty years as proof of lazy reading: grievance. Keepsake is killed by the burning; lodestar is the subtle trap.

WIC25C-03.note: Pigment shortage, discarded scraps laid over half-painted ochre in haste: improvised. Incidental is the near-miss but the gold recurs across a decade of her most-studied work.

WIC25C-04.note: The pamphlet called for exactly that poetry but no later poet saw it: anticipated, heralded. Guided is the near-miss and is killed only by 'none of them saw the pamphlet'.

WIC25C-05.note: Scraped and repainted in a new method he never abandoned: a turning-point landmark. Hybrid tempts (began polished) but the whole canvas was scraped; hoax and homage fall to 'signed openly' and 'seen nowhere'.

WIC25C-06.note: Omitted divorce, bankruptcy and feud; chapters stop at the dressing-room door: guarded. Gracious is the near-miss (unnamed bandmates) but omitting her own troubles is reticence, not generosity.

WIC25C-07.note: Doubt turned to faith and same-sex addresses altered: sanitized, laundered. Grouped and illustrated are struck by 'in the order she found them' and 'plain book'.

WIC25C-08.note: Repeated speeches, routinely cut, and the playwright's own regret make it a letdown; but a short mid-play scene that advances nothing is also accurately an interlude, so two options are defensible. Kernel and hinge are struck by 'settled only in the final act'.

WIC25D-01.note: Forty-one small fixes each tied to a complaint, by in-house technicians: patched. The auditors sentence alone decides it.

WIC25D-02.note: First to offer a feature the national apps then copied: pioneer. Middleman and referee are explicitly refused by 'keeping every payment' and 'settling their own complaints'.

WIC25D-03.note: Flat charge taking a larger share of a small income: regressive. Retroactive and opaque are each killed by one clause; punitive is the near-miss.

WIC25D-04.note: The upheld floor rarely bit but was later cited to win new cases: precedent. Remedy is the trap since the floor 'almost never came into play'.

WIC25D-05.note: Licensing, lawsuits, and repairs only by the maker: proprietary. Modular falls to 'single interlocked program', resilient to the lost day, outmoded to 'first'.

WIC25D-06.note: Stops moved and new roads taken with all twelve buses kept: redrawn. 'Pared' remains arguable because the long loops were cut and the longest ride shortened, saving fuel.

WIC25D-07.note: Director sat across from the owner and made the offers: negotiator. Organizer is killed by 'formed on its own'.

WIC25D-08.note: Billed once, returned at graduation for working laptops: refundable. Recurring and prohibitive fall to 'once' and 'nearly every family paid'.
